verses.text_urhobo: Emakashe ivẹ na de rhi te Sodọm vwẹ ovwọnvwọn, yi Lọt tidia ughere ri Sodọm, Ri Lọt vwọ mrẹ ayen, o de vrẹn ra vwa ayen, o de diguẹ bọvwọ opharo rhu otọ,
verses.text_romanized: emakashe ive na de rhi te sodom vwe ovwonvwon yi lot tidia ughere ri sodom ri lot vwo mre ayen o de vren ra vwa ayen o de digue bovwo opharo rhu oto

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta, Ọrovwovwe vwẹriẹ rhe, Me rẹ wẹ, uwevwi rẹ odibo wẹn re wọ dia Etiyin ason na, re wa hworhẹ awọ rẹ ovwan, re ọke de rhie irhiọke wa ke yanran. Ayen da ta, Ẹjo, evun rẹ urhuvwu na avwanre cha vwerhẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta orovwovwe vwerie rhe me re we uwevwi re odibo wen re wo dia etiyin ason na re wa hworhe awo re ovwan re oke de rhie irhioke wa ke yanran ayen da ta ejo evun re urhuvwu na avwanre cha vwerhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọda rẹ ayen gangan; kọye ayen da vwẹriẹ bro kpo uwevwi rọye, o de chere emu kẹ ayen, ọ da kaka ikara ro jephuo, ayen da re.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oda re ayen gangan koye ayen da vwerie bro kpo uwevwi roye o de chere emu ke ayen o da kaka ikara ro jephuo ayen da re

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo tavwe rẹ ayen ki rhi sherhẹ, eshare rẹ orere na, eshare ri Sodọm, te omotete te ọkpako, ihwo na ejobi tototo, de sogodogo riariẹ uwevwi na;
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo tavwe re ayen ki rhi sherhe eshare re orere na eshare ri sodom te omotete te okpako ihwo na ejobi tototo de sogodogo riarie uwevwi na

verses.text_urhobo: ayen de se Lọt, nẹ, Ke eshare ri wo uwevwi wẹn ason na rhọ? Reyọ ayen phia kẹ avwanre, rere avwanre vughe ayen.
verses.text_romanized: ayen de se lot ne ke eshare ri wo uwevwi wen ason na rho reyo ayen phia ke avwanre rere avwanre vughe ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Lọt da ro otafe ra vwa ihwo na, ọ da kare ẹchẹ gbe erhorha na,
verses.text_romanized: lot da ro otafe ra vwa ihwo na o da kare eche gbe erhorha na

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta, Me rẹ ovwan, imoni mẹ, we ruẹ emu umwemwu tiọnana-a.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta me re ovwan imoni me we rue emu umwemwu tionana a

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, mi vwo emetẹ ivẹ re je riẹn ọshare-e, ju vwe vwẹ ayen kẹ ovwan, ru we ru ayen obo ri je ovwan, ẹkẹvuọvo wa vwẹ obọ te erhorha mẹ na-a, kidie uwevwi mẹ ayen rhi wo.
verses.text_romanized: nighe mi vwo emete ive re je rien oshare e ju vwe vwe ayen ke ovwan ru we ru ayen obo ri je ovwan ekevuovo wa vwe obo te erhorha me na a kidie uwevwi me ayen rhi wo

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ayen da ta, Si te obuko, Ayen da tanẹ, Ohwo nana ro suosuo rhe na, kọye cha vwẹ oma ru obrorhiẹ, Avwanre vwẹ ẹro wẹn mrẹ oja nọ obo ri Me ru kẹ ihwo nana. Etiyin ayen de keke Lọt mu egba, kẹ ayen nyẹ ẹchẹ na re ọbẹre.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ayen da ta si te obuko ayen da tane ohwo nana ro suosuo rhe na koye cha vwe oma ru obrorhie avwanre vwe ero wen mre oja no obo ri me ru ke ihwo nana etiyin ayen de keke lot mu egba ke ayen nye eche na re obere

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ihwo na da riẹn obọ vwo kpono Lọt ro uwevwi, ayen de huhu ẹchẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ihwo na da rien obo vwo kpono lot ro uwevwi ayen de huhu eche

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da vwẹ egho rhurhu ihwo ri bi koko anurhoro na ẹro, te emọ te ekpako, ki ruẹ rhurhu vwẹ abọ guọnọ anurhoro.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da vwe egho rhurhu ihwo ri bi koko anurhoro na ero te emo te ekpako ki rue rhurhu vwe abo guono anurhoro

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ihwo na da ta ki Lọt Wo ji vwo ohwo ọfa vwẹ etinẹ? Egọ, emeshare, emetẹ eyẹ ohwo ọfa vwẹ orere na, sio nẹ asan na,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ihwo na da ta ki lot wo ji vwo ohwo ofa vwe etine ego emeshare emete eye ohwo ofa vwe orere na sio ne asan na

verses.text_urhobo: fikiridie avwanre cha ghwọrọ etinẹ na, kidie edo rẹ orukuruku rẹ ihwo nana rhi duvwu erhọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo, Ọrovwohwo kọye ri ji avwanre rhe re ghwọrọ na.
verses.text_romanized: fikiridie avwanre cha ghworo etine na kidie edo re orukuruku re ihwo nana rhi duvwu erho re orovwohwo orovwohwo koye ri ji avwanre rhe re ghworo na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Lọt da yan phia ra vuẹ egọ rọye nẹ, We vrẹn jọphẹre, ru we vrẹn nẹ etinẹ na, kidie Ọrovwohwo cha ghwọrọ orere na. Ẹkẹvuọvo egọ rọye da vwẹ ota na roro ehwẹjẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin lot da yan phia ra vue ego roye ne we vren jophere ru we vren ne etine na kidie orovwohwo cha ghworo orere na ekevuovo ego roye da vwe ota na roro ehweje

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọke rhi vwo rhie re, emakashe na ki bru Lọt okpakpa nẹ, Vrẹn, reyọ aye wẹn kugbe emetẹ wẹn ivẹ na ri etinẹ na, ayen da rha ghwọrọ vwẹ evun rẹ ẹguọghọ rẹ orere na.
verses.text_romanized: re oke rhi vwo rhie re emakashe na ki bru lot okpakpa ne vren reyo aye wen kugbe emete wen ive na ri etine na ayen da rha ghworo vwe evun re eguogho re orere na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ko gbe eghẹrẹ, kọye ihwo na de shabọ vwọ kugbe aye rọye kugbe emetẹ rọye ive na, ọ da yọnrọn ayen obọ, Ọrovwohwo ki nẹ aruẹdọ rọye, ayen da reyọ kpono nẹ evun rẹ orere na.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ko gbe eghere koye ihwo na de shabo vwo kugbe aye roye kugbe emete roye ive na o da yonron ayen obo orovwohwo ki ne aruedo roye ayen da reyo kpono ne evun re orere na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ayen vwọ reyọ ayen phihọ uphephẹ nu, ayen da ta, Djẹ kẹ arhọ wẹn, we nẹ obuko-o eyẹ we mudia vwẹ ukpotọ na-a, djẹ kpo obo ugbenu na, wa da ghwọrọ.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen vwo reyo ayen phiho uphephe nu ayen da ta dje ke arho wen we ne obuko o eye we mudia vwe ukpoto na a dje kpo obo ugbenu na wa da ghworo

verses.text_urhobo: Lọt da ta kẹ ayen, E, ẹjo, irivwovwe,
verses.text_romanized: lot da ta ke ayen e ejo irivwovwe

verses.text_urhobo: nighe, ọviẹn wẹn mrẹ aruesiri vwẹ obọ wẹn nure, we ni aruẹdọn mẹ gangan ri we vwo sivwi arhọ mẹ, yẹ ẹkẹvuọvo Me sa djẹ kpo obo igbenu na-a, ughwu de ke vwe phihọ, mi de rhe ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: nighe ovien wen mre aruesiri vwe obo wen nure we ni aruedon me gangan ri we vwo sivwi arho me ye ekevuovo me sa dje kpo obo igbenu na a ughwu de ke vwe phiho mi de rhe ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, orere rọ oboyi na kẹrobọ ra dje ra, o ke je havwe. Ju vwe djẹ kpo Etiyin - ọ dia ọhahavwe? - erhi mẹ kọ rhọ;
verses.text_romanized: nighe orere ro oboyi na kerobo ra dje ra o ke je havwe ju vwe dje kpo etiyin o dia ohahavwe erhi me ko rho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ, Nighe, Me je rhọvwe oyare nana kẹ wẹ rhe, Me gbe ghwọrọ orere na ro wọ tare na-a.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke nighe me je rhovwe oyare nana ke we rhe me gbe ghworo orere na ro wo tare na a

verses.text_urhobo: Jọphẹre, djẹ kpo Etiyin, kidie Me che ru emuọvo-o bẹsiẹ ru wo vwo te Etiyin. Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se odẹ rẹ orere na Zoar.
verses.text_romanized: jophere dje kpo etiyin kidie me che ru emuovo o besie ru wo vwo te etiyin fiki re otioye na e de se ode re orere na zoar

verses.text_urhobo: Ọnre ghwa vacha vwẹ ọke ri Lọt vwo te Zoar.
verses.text_romanized: onre ghwa vacha vwe oke ri lot vwo te zoar

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da rhọ osio rẹ ibieragha vẹ erhanre phihọ Sodọm vi Gomora nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da rho osio re ibieragha ve erhanre phiho sodom vi gomora ne obo odjuvwu rhe

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ghwọrọ irere yena ejobi, vẹ ishekpotọ na ejobi, kugbe ẹbe re djẹ vwẹ otọ na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: o da ghworo irere yena ejobi ve ishekpoto na ejobi kugbe ebe re dje vwe oto na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo aye ri Lọt rọ ka obuko de ni obuko, o de hirhe phihọ ẹrhẹnre rẹ ughweraka.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo aye ri lot ro ka obuko de ni obuko o de hirhe phiho erhenre re ughweraka

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da yan vwẹ irhiọke ride vwo kpo asan ro de mudia vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo na,
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da yan vwe irhioke ride vwo kpo asan ro de mudia vwe obaro re orovwohwo na

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da kpare opharo ni Sodọm vi Gomora kugbe ishekpotọ na, nighe, o vwo ni, ivwirhi rẹ orho na de bru kpenu kerẹ erhanre re etu.
verses.text_romanized: o da kpare opharo ni sodom vi gomora kugbe ishekpoto na nighe o vwo ni ivwirhi re orho na de bru kpenu kere erhanre re etu

verses.text_urhobo: Ke eriyin ọ epha, vwẹ ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ guọghọ irere rẹ ishekpotọ na, Ọghẹnẹ da karohọ Ebraham, o de si Lọt nu uherevie rẹ erhanre na, vwẹ ọke ra vwọ torhẹ orere ri Lọt diare.
verses.text_romanized: ke eriyin o epha vwe oke re oghene vwo guogho irere re ishekpoto na oghene da karoho ebraham o de si lot nu uherevie re erhanre na vwe oke ra vwo torhe orere ri lot diare

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke yena Lọt de vrẹn ni Zoar, vwo kpo enu rẹ ugbenu ọ vẹ emetẹ rọye ivẹ na, fiki rẹ oshọ rọ vwọ dia Zoar muro; evun rẹ emwa kọye ọ vẹ emetẹ rọye ivẹ na diare.
verses.text_romanized: oke yena lot de vren ni zoar vwo kpo enu re ugbenu o ve emete roye ive na fiki re osho ro vwo dia zoar muro evun re emwa koye o ve emete roye ive na diare

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rẹ ọkpako da ta kẹ ọ rẹ otete, Ọsẹ rẹ avwanre ghwo re, yẹ o vwo ohwo ọvuọvo vwẹ akpọ na ro bru avwanre rhe kirobo re ruẹ vwẹ akpọ na-a.
verses.text_romanized: o re okpako da ta ke o re otete ose re avwanre ghwo re ye o vwo ohwo ovuovo vwe akpo na ro bru avwanre rhe kirobo re rue vwe akpo na a

verses.text_urhobo: Yanrhe, re avwanre vwẹ idi kẹ da, rere avwanre wan oma rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre vwo emọ.
verses.text_romanized: yanrhe re avwanre vwe idi ke da rere avwanre wan oma re ose re avwanre vwo emo

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da vwẹ idi kẹ ọsẹ rayen da ason yena; oro ọkpako de bru ọsẹ rọye kpo ovwerhẹ, ọ riẹn ọke ro vwo sherhẹẹ ọ je riẹn ọke ro vwo vrẹ-ẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da vwe idi ke ose rayen da ason yena oro okpako de bru ose roye kpo ovwerhe o rien oke ro vwo sherhee o je rien oke ro vwo vre en

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rivẹ, oro ọkpako da ta kẹ ọ rẹ otete, Nighe, Me vẹ ọsẹ Me ri gbe sherhẹ ason rọ wanre na, jẹ a je vwẹ udi kẹ da vwẹ ason na rhe, rere wọ vẹ ọye je vwerhẹ rhe, rere vwẹ oma rọye uvwiẹ rẹ avwanre vwo je fue.
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede rive oro okpako da ta ke o re otete nighe me ve ose me ri gbe sherhe ason ro wanre na je a je vwe udi ke da vwe ason na rhe rere wo ve oye je vwerhe rhe rere vwe oma roye uvwie re avwanre vwo je fue

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da je vwẹ udi kẹ ọsẹ rayen da vwẹ ason yena rhe, ọ rẹ otete vrẹnri, ọ vẹ ọye de shevwerhẹ, ọ riẹn ọke ro vwo sherhẹ-ẹ ọ je riẹn ọke ro vwo vrẹ-ẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da je vwe udi ke ose rayen da vwe ason yena rhe o re otete vrenri o ve oye de shevwerhe o rien oke ro vwo sherhe e o je rien oke ro vwo vre en

verses.text_urhobo: Enẹ kọye emetẹ ri Lọt ivẹ na wan oma rẹ ọsẹ rayen mrevun.
verses.text_romanized: ene koye emete ri lot ive na wan oma re ose rayen mrevun

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rẹ ọkpako na de vwiẹ ọmọshare, o de se odẹ rọye Moab, kọye ọsẹ rẹ ihwo ri Moab rhi te nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: o re okpako na de vwie omoshare o de se ode roye moab koye ose re ihwo ri moab rhi te none na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rẹ otete de ji vwiẹ ọmọshare, o de se odẹ rọye Ben-ammi, kọye ọsẹ rẹ ihwo rẹ Ammọn rhi te nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: o re otete de ji vwie omoshare o de se ode roye ben ammi koye ose re ihwo re ammon rhi te none na

headings.text_urhobo: Asan rẹ ihwo ri Moab kugbe ihwo rẹ Ammọn nurhe
headings.text_romanized: asan re ihwo ri moab kugbe ihwo re ammon nurhe
